chapters.label: Live: the 2022 final
chapters.text: The 2022 Futsal Champions League final. Barcelona lead Sporting. Pito wins the ball in the middle, drives forward and scores. Two nil!

chapters.label: Replay: behind the goal
chapters.text: Watch again, in slow motion. He steals it, and carries it forward with his head up. He finishes past the keeper, just before half time.

chapters.label: How he does it
chapters.text: His famous move is the pivot spin. Here’s how he does it: back to goal, he feels the defender lean one way, then spins the other way and shoots!

chapters.label: Your turn
chapters.text: Your turn. Feel where the defender is, then turn the other way!
